Baby leaves, pea shoots, cucumber and herbs in lettuce cups with a lemon and honey dressing and crumbled feta.
the diamond auction at the Gotham botanical gardens

Crisp little pastry cases filled with crab, lemon mayo and chives, topped with avocado and a sparkle of salmon roe. Cut 24 rounds from 2 sheets of shortcrust pastry, press into mini muffin tins, prick and bake at 190C for 12 minutes until golden, then cool. Mix 250g drained crab meat with 3 tbsp mayo, the zest and a squeeze of 1 lemon, 2 tbsp chopped chives and salt. Dice 1 avocado with lemon juice. Fill each case with crab, a little avocado and a few salmon roe.
M: thawing out after Gotham freezes over

Beef chuck slow cooked with kidney beans, chipotle, cumin and tomato until thick and smoky, with sour cream, cheddar and warm cornbread. Brown 1kg diced beef chuck in batches. Soften 2 onions and 3 garlic cloves, add 2 tsp cumin, 2 chopped chipotles in adobo, 2 cans crushed tomatoes, 500ml beef stock and the beef. Cover and simmer 2.5 hours, adding 2 drained cans kidney beans for the last 30 minutes. Mix 200g cornmeal, 150g plain flour, 2 tsp baking powder, 2 eggs, 300ml milk and 80g melted butter and bake at 200C for 22 minutes.
Chicken thighs simmered with carrot, celery and egg noodles
Chicken thighs simmered with carrot, celery, onion and noodles until tender, finished with parsley and lemon.
W: Chocolate biscuit base layered with vanilla and mint ice cream
Layers of vanilla and mint ice cream on a chocolate biscuit base, frozen overnight, topped with crushed meringue like snow.
K: Lemonade ice cubes blended with blue butterfly pea tea into a slush

Frozen lemonade blitzed into an icy slush with butterfly pea tea for an icy blue glow, with a squeeze of lime to finish. Steep 1 tbsp dried butterfly pea flowers in 250ml boiling water for 10 minutes, strain and stir in 3 tbsp sugar, then chill. Pour 750ml lemonade into an ice cube tray and freeze overnight. Blend the lemonade cubes with the blue tea and 2 cups of ice until slushy. Spoon into 4 glasses and serve with spoon straws and lime wedges.

Mix the mayonnaise with tomato sauce, lemon juice and hot sauce.

steps.text: Separate the cos into small cups.
Toss the pea shoots, cucumber and mint with lemon juice, honey and olive oil.
Spoon into the cups and crumble feta over the top.
Put the chicken, carrots, celery and onion in a pot with the water.
Simmer until the chicken is cooked.
Shred the chicken back into the pot.
Add the noodles and cook.

Put the carrots, celery and onion in a pot with the stock and water.
Simmer until the vegetables are tender, then lift out the onion.
Add the beans and noodles and cook for 5 minutes.
Finish with the parsley and a squeeze of lemon.

Soften the ice creams and layer over the base.
Freeze overnight.
Top with crushed meringue like fresh snow just before slicing.

s.note: Cooked prawns on crushed ice with a mayo, tomato sauce and lemon dip
s.how: Pile crushed ice onto a platter and arrange 500g cooked prawns on top. Mix 4 tbsp mayonnaise with 2 tbsp tomato sauce, a squeeze of lemon and a dash of hot sauce. Serve in a small bowl in the middle. Everybody chill.

s.note: Baby cos cups filled with pea shoots, cucumber, mint and feta
s.how: Separate baby cos lettuce into small cups. Toss pea shoots, sliced cucumber and mint with lemon juice and a little honey and olive oil. Spoon into the cups and crumble feta over the top. Green, leafy and only slightly dangerous.

m.note: Chicken thighs simmered with carrot, celery and egg noodles
m.how: Simmer 600g chicken thighs with 2 carrots, 2 celery sticks and an onion in 2L water for 40 minutes. Shred the chicken back in, add 150g egg noodles and cook 5 minutes. Finish with chopped parsley and a squeeze of lemon.

w.note: Chocolate biscuit base layered with vanilla and mint ice cream
w.how: Crush 250g chocolate biscuits with 80g melted butter and press into a tin. Soften 1L vanilla and 1L mint ice cream and layer over the base. Freeze overnight. Top with crushed meringue nests like fresh snow just before slicing.

Blend the lemonade cubes with the blue tea and 2 cups of ice until slushy. Spoon into 4 glasses and serve with spoon straws and lime wedges.
